name: Centermass
description: High-end weapons and armor dealer in the ArcCorp megacity. Sells premium grade rifles, pistols, and heavy armor suits.
note: Sells the P4-AR assault rifle and the Demeco LMG

name: Cubby Blast
description: General military surplus store selling weapons, ammunition, armor, and ship components at competitive prices.
note: One-stop shop for military gear in Area18

name: Tammany & Sons
description: Clothing and light armor outfitter offering casual wear, flight suits, and personal defense gear.
note: Also sells backpacks and utility belts

name: Old 'Verse Supply
description: General ship components and parts supplier — a relic of old Earth repurposed for Stanton's ship maintenance needs.

name: Platinum Bay
description: Chain weapons and armor store found in major landing zones. Sells reliable mid-tier gear at reasonable prices.
note: Platinum Bay locations share inventory across all planets

name: Dumper's Depot
description: Ship components and vehicle parts retailer. Part of the Dumper's Depot franchise chain.

name: Live Fire Weapons
description: Focused ballistic weapons dealer in Lorville's Teasa Spaceport. Specializes in kinetic and ballistic weaponry.
note: Best ballistic weapon selection in Lorville

name: M & V Armoring
description: Heavy industrial armor and protective gear for Hurston's harsh environment and security needs.

name: Tammany & Sons
description: Clothing and armor outfitter in Lorville's commercial district. Stocks durable workwear and light armor.
note: Second Tammany & Sons location in Stanton

name: Cousin Crows
description: Ship weapons and vehicle components dealer. The premier location for outfitting your ship's offensive capabilities.

name: Platinum Bay
description: Chain weapons and armor store in Lorville. Same reliable inventory as other Platinum Bay locations.
note: Located near the spaceport commercial area

name: The Factory Line
description: Industrial workwear and undersuit specialist. Stocks durable clothing for Hurston's factory workers and miners.

name: Platinum Bay
description: Chain weapons and armor store in New Babbage's plaza. Serves the needs of microTech residents and visitors.
note: Located in the New Babbage main commercial plaza

name: Omega Pro
description: Premium armor and clothing boutique in New Babbage. Curated selection of fashionable and functional gear.

name: Shubin Interstellar
description: Mining equipment and resource extraction tools. Shubin Interstellar is the premier mining supply company in the Empire.
note: Sells all mining gadgets and consumables

name: Tammany & Sons
description: Clothing store in New Babbage offering stylish casual and professional attire suitable for the corporate planet.

name: Cousin Crows
description: Ship components and weapon systems dealer in New Babbage. Stocks everything from quantum drives to missile racks.

name: Platinum Bay
description: Platinum Bay location on the floating platform of Orison. Stocks the standard Platinum Bay inventory of weapons and armor.
note: Located in the Orison commercial district

name: Omega Pro
description: Armor and clothing boutique on Orison's cloud city platforms. Carries weather-resistant gear suitable for the gas giant environment.

name: Cousin Crows
description: Ship components dealer on Orison. Specializes in atmospheric flight components and Crusader-manufactured parts.
note: Good selection of Crusader Industries components

name: The Factory Line
description: Clothing and undersuit store on Orison. Stocks flight-ready suits and casual cloud city apparel.

name: Platinum Bay
description: Limited selection Platinum Bay at Everus Harbor, the orbital station above Hurston. Stocks essential weapons and armor.
note: Reduced inventory compared to planetary locations

name: Cousin Crows
description: Ship components kiosk at Everus Harbor orbital station. Stocks essential ship parts and upgrades.
note: Orbital station outlet with common components

name: Platinum Bay
description: Platinum Bay at Port Tressler, the orbital station above microTech. Limited inventory of personal defense items.
note: Reduced inventory compared to planetary locations

name: Cousin Crows
description: Ship components and weapon kiosk at Port Tressler. Carries common ship parts for quick outfitting.

name: Platinum Bay
description: Platinum Bay at Baijini Point, the orbital station above ArcCorp. Limited selection of essential gear.
note: Located in the station's commercial hub

name: Cousin Crows
description: Ship components and weapon kiosk at Baijini Point orbital station. Stocks essential ship upgrades and parts.

name: Platinum Bay
description: Platinum Bay at Seraphim Station, the orbital station above Crusader. Limited personal defense inventory.

name: Cousin Crows
description: Ship components kiosk at Seraphim Station. Carries Crusader-adjacent components and common ship parts.
note: Smaller inventory than planetary Cousin Crows

name: Seraphim Station Food Court
description: Multiple food and beverage kiosks serving travelers at Seraphim Station.

name: Everus Harbor Food Court
description: Food and drink vendors at Everus Harbor orbital station.

name: Port Tressler Food Court
description: Convenience food and drink kiosks at Port Tressler orbital station.

name: Baijini Point Food Court
description: Food and beverage vendors serving travelers at Baijini Point orbital station.

name: Platinum Bay
description: Very limited Platinum Bay kiosk at R&R HUR-L1 rest stop. Stocks only basic weapons and sidearms.

name: Ship Weapon Kiosk
description: Automated ship weapon kiosk at R&R HUR-L2 rest stop. Basic selection of size 1-3 ship weapons.

name: Platinum Bay
description: Limited Platinum Bay kiosk at R&R ARC-L1 rest stop. Basic weaponry for travelers in need.

name: Ship Component Kiosk
description: Automated ship component kiosk at R&R ARC-L2. Stocks basic coolers, power plants, and shields.

name: Food & Drink Vending
description: Automated vending machines at R&R MIC-L1 rest stop. Snacks and drinks for the weary traveler.

name: Platinum Bay
description: Platinum Bay kiosk at R&R CRU-L1 rest stop. Limited selection of personal defense weapons.

name: Orison Medical Clinic
description: Medical supply and respawn clinic on Orison. Stocks medical gowns, healing supplies, and medical equipment.
note: Also serves as a respawn point

name: New Babbage Medical Center
description: Full-service medical facility in New Babbage. Provides medical supplies, healing items, and respawn services.

name: Lorville Medical Clinic
description: Industrial medical clinic serving Lorville's workers. Basic medical supplies and emergency care.
